title: Support both NodeJS and Browser rollup
body:
This pull request includes updates to the dependencies and modifications to the `RollupBundler` to support both browser and Node.js environments. The most important changes include updating the `rollup` dependency and modifying the `RollupBundler` to conditionally use the appropriate `rollup` instance based on the environment.

Dependency updates:

* [`packages/compiler/package.json`](diffhunk://#diff-11f1c967e7b88e8bb1ad9292bc77da6ad6ac034c264ce56eed069eb1e19865deR18): Added `rollup` version `^4.34.1` to the dependencies.
* [`pnpm-lock.yaml`](diffhunk://#diff-32824c984905bb02bc7ffcef96a77addd1f1602cff71a11fbbfdd7f53ee026bbR99-R101): Added `rollup` with specifier `^4.34.1` and version `4.36.0`.

Code modifications for environment support:

* `packages/compiler/src/compilers/RollupBundler.ts`: 
  * Changed imports to conditionally import `rollup` from either `@rollup/browser` or `rollup` based on the environment.
  * Modified the `build` method to use the appropriate `rollup` instance (`nodeRollUp` or `browserRollUp`) based on whether the code is running in a Node.js environment.

title: Publish configuration
body:
This pull request introduces a new GitHub Actions workflow for releasing the package and updates the package version in `package.json`.

### New GitHub Actions workflow for release:

* [`.github/workflows/release.yml`](diffhunk://#diff-87db21a973eed4fef5f32b267aa60fcee5cbdf03c67fafdc2a9b553bb0b15f34R1-R26): Added a new workflow to automate the release process. The workflow triggers on release creation, sets up the Node.js environment, installs dependencies using `pnpm`, and publishes the package to NPM.

title: Detailed failure information in test results
body:
## Description

Currently, when running tests, the output provides results upon success. However, in the event of a failure, there is no information indicating the cause of the failure.

## Requested Features

#### Detailed Failure Information

When a test fails, display information explaining why the failure occurred.

## Additional Feature Request

#### 1. Execution Time Display

Previously, the duration until task completion was displayed, but it is no longer visible. It would be very helpful if the display of execution time for each test is given.

#### 2. Comprehensive Failure Details

Is it possible to provide more detailed information regarding the cause of test failures?
Implementing these features would greatly enhance the debugging process and improve the overall quality of the library.
